records.scope: Entire 365.95-second Solo rules-test battle, setup through all 12 turns and final results
key_findings: After Will guaranteed the initial first coin as heads, Victory Star rerolled it to tails. The guarantee was not applied again to the replacement sequence.
Zangoose Counterattack returned 20 damage after a lethal hit, producing two knockouts and one point each. A zero-damage attack produced no return damage.
With two Victini present, an attack received one Victory Star reroll. Printed text explicitly limits the ability to one use per turn.
Bounded Field doubled a one-head Double Smash from 40 to 80 against Fire-weak ordinary Pokemon.
limitations: No Confused Pokemon attempts an attack in this recording.
The Mega Evolution ex exception, non-Fire attacks and broader Will interactions were not tested.
Hidden cards remain unknown; test choices are not competitive-policy grades.

records.scope: Entire 577.671667-second Solo rules-test battle, setup through all 22 turns and final Victory
records.outcome_description: Victory; 4-2 actual awarded points, with owner circles capped at three; 22 turns
key_findings: Victory Star replaced Heat Charged 0 heads/3 tails with 2 heads/1 tail. One starting Fire became three; the original coin batch did not add Energy.
Umbreon Dark Binding blocked a Basic from attacking. A new Active could attack after retreat, and evolving the affected Darumaka to Darmanitan cleared its block while preserving 40 damage.
Flame Patch supplied discarded Fire to the new Active Darumaka after the normal turn attachment had already been used.
Greedent healed from 80 to 90 with Leftovers at the end of its turn while active.
limitations: Failed Confusion checks and Will with Victory Star were not tested here.
Bounded Field was present, but this recording did not test its numerical weakness multiplier.
Hidden cards and exact obstructed animation digits remain qualified.

records.scope: Entire 409.606667-second Solo rules-test battle, loading and setup through all 14 turns and final results
records.outcome_description: Defeat, owner 0 and opponent 4 actual awarded points, with opponent circles capped at 3;14 turns;120 displayed damage
key_findings: Victory Star replaced Heat Charged1H/2T with another1H/2T; the Active gained one Fire rather than adding both batches. Later-turn prompts and kept original results matched settled Energy.
Netherwing required three Fire plus one Colorless. The observed attempt with only two Fire was refused.
Double Smash kept two heads for80, then replaced two tails with one head/one tail for40. Settled HP changes matched both results.
Flame Patch added discarded Fire to Active Darmanitan, while a distinct ordinary attachment went to Benched Moltres.
Two ordinary ex knockouts awarded two points each; the opponent score display stopped at three.
limitations: Only one Victini was in play; multiple-Victini enforcement was not tested.
Will and Team Rockets Master Plan were drawn or inspected and not played.
Successful Netherwing, matching weakness multiplication, Disguise, and settled terminal Fantasia Force Energy allocation were not tested.

records.scope: Entire 465.875488-second Solo rules-test battle, setup through all 20 turns and final Victory
key_findings: Will did not force the separate Confusion check to heads. The check was tails and the selected attack failed.
No Victory Star reroll was offered after the observed failed Confusion check; HP and seven Fire Energy stayed unchanged.
Double Smash dealt 60 with one head against Bronzong: 40 doubled by Bounded Field, then reduced by Guard Press 20. The reversed order would have produced 40.
Bounded Field's Mega exception concerns the attacker. Both attackers tested here were non-Mega Pokemon.
An empty deck skipped the draw while play continued to the knockout win.
limitations: This recording does not test Will on an accepted Victory Star replacement sequence; the separate first recording does.
No Mega-attacker interaction or general ordering of every damage modifier was tested.
Hidden cards and policy intentions beyond the stated test scope remain unknown.

records.scope: Entire 212.071667-second AI Solo rules-test battle, loading and setup through all eight turns and final results
records.outcome_description: Victory; owner four actual awarded points versus opponent two, with owner circles capped at three; eight turns; 320 displayed damage
key_findings: Two benched Ariados increased the retreat-cost amount used by Grass Knot: 40 + 30 x (Moltres printed two + one + one) = 160. Actual retreat payment was not tested.
Infernape Flare Blitz used two Fire and displayed 160 including weakness against each Whimsicott ex. All attached Fire were discarded after each attack.
One Flame Patch plus the ordinary attachment restored the two Fire needed for the final Flare Blitz. A second Patch was drawn and remained in hand.
Each Whimsicott ex knockout awarded two points; the owner earned four total while score circles capped at three. The 320 displayed damage included overkill.
limitations: No paid retreat or Leaf/X Speed interaction was tested.
No Grass Knot was used against Infernape; the second Whimsicott had only one Grass and did not attack.
Quick-Grow first-turn/newly-played restrictions, hidden decks and random-selection distribution were not tested.

records.scope: Entire 217.453333-second Solo rules-test battle, available setup through all nine turns and final Defeat
records.outcome_description: Defeat with owner 2 points and opponent 1 after the last owner Pokemon was knocked out; nine turns; 230 displayed damage
key_findings: Wild Swing discarded Mega Sharpedo ex and Mega Gyarados ex without awarding opponent points. Two discards produced 100 damage, matching 20 + 40 + 40.
Wild Swing still attacked with an empty Bench: 20 base plus 20 weakness dealt 40.
Wallace fetched a compatible Water evolution from the deck and evolved 50-HP Carvanha into Mega Sharpedo ex.
Turbo Shark added a third Water to benched Gyarados after knocking out Ogerpon, while Mega Sharpedo retained its attached Water.
The final knockout left the owner with no Pokemon, and Defeat followed despite a 2-1 point lead.
limitations: Carvanha entered on an earlier turn, so same-turn Basic evolution permission was not tested.
The second Misty target was unclear; immediate tails gave no Energy to any target.
Carefree Steps heads, actual Energy discard from Destructive Inferno, and a Mega ex knockout point award were not tested.

records.scope: Entire 363.465-second rules-test battle, loading and setup through all 11 turns, Victory and final loading
records.outcome_description: Victory, 3-2 points, after Greninja Water Shuriken knocked out Typhlosion ex; 11 global turns
key_findings: Destructive Inferno effect coins and Victory Star resolved after Gabite displayed zero HP and before the knockout point. Original tails became two heads then tails.
Against the initially zero-Energy Froakie, tails again became two heads then tails. The No Energy attached message appeared after its Active spot was empty.
The surviving Garchomp took 110 once, then original and replacement tails left both Water and Fighting Energy attached.
Gible evolution cleared Burned while preserving 20 damage. Lucky Ice Pop then healed 20 and was discarded after tails.
Greninja Water Shuriken dealt 20 to selected targets; its final knockout of an ex awarded two points and the win.
Gabite Linear Attack dealt 50 to Active Quilava. Dragon Gabite did not match Water weakness, so this does not establish a weakness-bypass rule.
limitations: The lethal two-head result equaled all two attached Energy. Their disappearance cannot be independently attributed to attack discard versus knockout cleanup.
Random Energy selection and positive-head discard from a surviving target were not tested.
Explicit Solo/PvP mode, opponent automation and full hidden decks remain unknown. The final Battle Results page was not supplied, but Victory and 3-2 points were established.
